verses.text: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
He cuts off every branch in me that does not produce fruit. And he trims every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
You are already clean because of the message I have spoken to you.
Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. A branch cannot produce fruit by itself. It must stay joined to the vine. In the same way, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me and I to you, you will produce a lot of fruit. Without me you can do nothing.
Anyone who does not stay joined to me is like a branch that is thrown away and dries up. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire and burned.
If you stay joined to me and my words stay in you, ask for whatever you want, and it will be done for you.
My Father is given glory when you produce a lot of fruit. This shows that you are my followers.
I have loved you just as the Father has loved me. Stay in my love.
If you obey my commands, you will stay in my love, just as I have obeyed my Father's commands and stay in his love.
I have told you this so that my joy may be in you, and so that your joy may be complete.
This is my command: love one another, just as I have loved you.
The greatest love a person can show is to give up their life for their friends.
You are my friends if you do what I command you.
I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know what his master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because I have told you everything I have heard from my Father.
You did not choose me. I chose you, and I appointed you to go and produce fruit that will last. Then the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
This is my command: love one another.
If the world hates you, remember that it hated me first.
If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. But you do not belong to the world. I have chosen you out of the world, and that is why the world hates you.
Remember what I told you: 'A servant is not greater than his master.' If people persecuted me, they will persecute you too. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours too.
They will treat you like this because of my name, because they do not know the one who sent me.
If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.
If I had not done among them the works that no one else has ever done, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have seen these works, and still they have hated both me and my Father.
This has happened so that what is written in their Law would come true: 'They hated me for no reason.'
I will send you the Helper from the Father. He is the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father. When he comes, he will tell you about me.
And you also must tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning."
